name: arc-chat-overlay

scripts.build:watcher: python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --name arc-watcher --distpath build/watcher-dist --workpath build/pyi --specpath build/pyi --exclude-module numpy --collect-binaries winsdk --hidden-import winsdk.windows.media.ocr --hidden-import winsdk.windows.graphics.imaging --hidden-import winsdk.windows.storage --hidden-import winsdk.windows.foundation --hidden-import winsdk.windows.foundation.collections --hidden-import winsdk.windows.globalization --hidden-import winsdk.windows.storage.streams ../arc_watcher.py
scripts.dist: npm run build:watcher && npm run dist:app

description: In-game text chat overlay for ARC Raiders
author: ARC Chat
